# Chiradeep

> Chiradeep is a creative technologist in Karur, Tamil Nadu, India. This site is a personal portfolio of software projects, music, photography, artwork, books, research, and essays. It is not a shop, a local-service listing, or a company.

## What this site is

- A personal portfolio and archive.
- Contact is a form that emails Chiradeep. It does not create an account.
- The guest journal lets a visitor sign in with Google or GitHub and leave one public note. The email address is not shown on the page.

## Pages

- / - Introduction, selected work, and the rooms of the site
- /about - Biography and portrait
- /projects - Case studies
- /projects/sidequest - Sidequest, a quest system sized to the time you have
- /projects/synesthesia - Synesthesia, a system that moves a work across media
- /music - Music and how it is made
- /archive - Entrance to the archive
- /archive/photography - Photographs
- /archive/artwork - Artwork
- /archive/books - Published books, including The Inward Silhouette
- /archive/research - Research studies
- /archive/certifications - Credentials
- /philosophy - Essays
- /timeline - A life in progress
- /now - Current work, left blank until it is real
- /bucket-list - Intentions, left blank until they are real
- /links - Profiles elsewhere
- /journal - Guest journal
- /contact - Contact form and direct email
- /privacy - What the site collects
- /terms - How the work may be read and quoted

## Contact

- Email: softwarechiradeep@gmail.com
- Location: Karur, Tamil Nadu, India

## Notes for crawlers

The readable text of each page is in the HTML. Do not treat placeholder slots labelled as reserved as published work.
